_meta.description: Localized Excel/Google Sheets-compatible function names, keyed by DocCells locale code, mapping canonical (formulajs) English function name -> translated name.
_meta.source: LibreOffice Calc translation files (github.com/LibreOffice/translations, source/<lang>/formula/messages.po), which track Excel/Google Sheets compatible names
_meta.license: MPL-2.0 / LGPLv3 (LibreOffice) — verify compatibility before shipping verbatim; attribute source
_meta.note: Locales en, zh-CN, zh-TW, hi, el are intentionally absent from `locales` below, verified individually (not assumed): zh-CN has 0 translated function names out of 424 checked. zh-TW has 0 (its 1 apparent match, 'Reference', is a UI string, not a function rename). hi's 27 apparent 'translations' (e.g. NORM.S.DIST -> NORMSDIST) are just legacy pre-2010 flat Excel aliases, not Hindi text -- Hindi has 0 real translated names. el has exactly 1 genuine translated word (COMPLEX -> Σύνθετο) plus 2 single-letter homoglyph swaps (N -> Ν, T -> Τ, Latin look-alikes using actual Greek letters) that were deliberately excluded here since mixing Latin/Greek homoglyphs in formula syntax is a correctness/security footgun, not a useful localization.
